notes.scope: one-route pricing engine: current cargo demand, Gulf prompt VLCC supply and relative origin/destination inventories in; spot TCE out
notes.state_separation: fleet operations publish prompt_supply_vlcc; pricing does not move ships
notes.time_contract: loading consumes zero turns; laden voyage two turns; East Asia discharge one turn; ballast return two turns
notes.inventory_scope: inventory values are deviations from a normal pipeline, not absolute regional stocks
notes.price_scope: real 2025 USD/day TCE is formed first and then nominalized by CPI
notes.excluded_scope: all voyage costs, vessel OPEX, owner cash flow, debt, interest, depreciation, ship values, newbuildings, scrapping and bargaining agents
notes.validation_supply: lag daily cargo rate, scale to current turn days; never lag a differently sized window total
notes.zero_demand: carry last indicative TCE without a new price observation; no executed fixture price
